# ExternalFieldAnalogy

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
The mapping of a synaptic or input drive (Γ_st) to the external magnetic field h in the Landau-Ginzburg free energy. Enables analysis of how external stimuli control the computational phase and response of iNEST systems, analogous to magnetic field effects.
